# La Union Gateway

Website: https://launiongateway.com/

La Union Gateway is a La Union, Philippines accommodation discovery platform being developed to help travelers find places to stay and connect directly with accommodation providers.

## Current status

The public website is currently a pre-launch landing page.

Current public focus:
- Accommodation discovery in La Union, Philippines
- Hotels
- Resorts
- Hostels
- Transient houses
- Villas
- Apartelles
- Guest houses
- Boutique hotels

## Coverage

La Union Gateway is being developed to cover municipalities and destinations across La Union, including San Juan, San Fernando City, Bauang, Bacnotan, Luna, Agoo, and other municipalities in the province.

## Planned sections

The full La Union Gateway directory is planned to include:
- Stays
- Explore
- List Your Business
- About

## For accommodation owners

Accommodation owners will be able to showcase their properties so travelers can discover them and contact the provider directly.
